Subject: Harlow Brook statement of work
Date: Friday 25 September 2026
From: Dom Selvon <dom@valliance.ai>
To: Priya Nandra <priya.nandra@harlowbrook.example.test>

Hi Priya,

The statement of work is attached, fixed price, with the assumptions set out in section four.

Two things from my side. I will send the revised timeline on Thursday once the team has sized the migration. Could you confirm the data warehouse access by Wednesday so we are not guessing?

Best,
Dom

expected.description: Send Priya Nandra the revised timeline once the team has sized the migration

notes: The request for data access is a question put to the counterparty, not a commitment either party has made.
